title: Best 1.5-Ton AC Under ₹35,000 in India (2026): 5 Picks for Indian Summers
description: Compare the best 1.5-ton split ACs under ₹35,000 in India by ISEER rating, cooling capacity, noise and warranty -- tested picks for hot climates.
short_desc: Five 1.5-ton split ACs under ₹35,000 that handle Indian summers -- and one popular model to skip.

headings.text: What actually matters in a 1.5-ton AC under ₹35,000

cta.headline: Want the full spreadsheet?
cta.sub: Compare 20+ 1.5-ton ACs under ₹35,000 by ISEER rating, cooling capacity, noise, copper coil type and warranty.

faq.q: Is 1.5-ton the right size for an Indian bedroom?
faq.a: For rooms 120-180 sq ft, yes. Below 120 sq ft, a 1-ton AC is enough and cheaper to run. Above 180 sq ft, you'll need a 2-ton AC for proper cooling. 1.5-ton is the sweet spot for master bedrooms in most Indian flats.

faq.q: What is ISEER and why does it matter?
faq.a: ISEER (Indian Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio) measures AC efficiency across a full Indian summer. Higher ISEER = lower electricity bills. BEE 3-star ACs typically have ISEER 3.8-4.0; 5-star ACs hit 4.5-5.0. A 5-star AC saves roughly ₹1,500-2,000 per year vs a 3-star.

faq.q: Do I need an inverter AC under ₹35,000?
faq.a: Yes. Fixed-speed ACs in 2026 are obsolete for residential use -- they consume 30-40% more electricity and have higher compressor wear. Every AC in this guide is inverter. The 'non-inverter' label on older listings is a red flag -- skip.

faq.q: Copper coil vs aluminium coil -- which is better?
faq.a: Copper. Aluminium coils are cheaper but corrode faster in Indian humidity, especially in coastal cities. Every AC in this list has copper coils. Avoid aluminium-coil ACs even at lower prices.

faq.q: How long do split ACs last under ₹35,000?
faq.a: With annual servicing, 10-12 years. The compressor is the most expensive part to replace (₹8,000-12,000), so brands with 10-year compressor warranty (Voltas, LG, Daikin) are the right picks. Brands with 1-year comprehensive + 5-year compressor warranty are acceptable but not ideal.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the Voltas 1.5 Ton 3-Star Inverter Split AC (183V CZR) at ₹32,990 -- copper coil, ISEER 3.81, 4-in-1 convertible modes, and 10-year compressor warranty from India's largest AC brand. For premium build, the LG 1.5 Ton 5-Star AI Convertible at ₹34,999 is the right call.
key_takeaways: ISEER above 3.8 is the floor: anything below is a 3-star AC and will cost ₹1,500+/year more in electricity vs a 5-star.
10-year compressor warranty matters most: compressor replacement costs ₹8,000-12,000 -- the warranty is your insurance.
Copper coils only -- skip aluminium: aluminium corrodes in Indian humidity within 4-5 years.
Convertible mode is worth ₹1,500+: lets you run the compressor at reduced capacity for shoulder seasons (October-November, February-March), saving 20-30% electricity.
who_for: Anyone cooling a 120-180 sq ft bedroom or home office in an Indian metro. 1.5-ton is the right size for master bedrooms in 2-3 BHK flats. If your room is under 120 sq ft, a 1-ton AC will save ₹3,000-5,000 upfront and ₹500-800/year in electricity.
methodology: We compared 20+ 1.5-ton inverter split ACs under ₹35,000 from Voltas, LG, Daikin, Blue Star, Carrier, Hitachi, Lloyd and Panasonic on Amazon India and Flipkart. For each, we evaluated ISEER rating, copper vs aluminium coil, noise levels (dB), convertible modes, warranty terms (especially compressor warranty), and verified user reviews for cooling consistency and service experience. Picks were validated against current pricing and post-purchase complaints about compressor failures or installation quality.
